title: It's Great to Be a Cow in World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: Mulgore has wide skies, prairie grass, and the great plateaus of Thunder Bluff. It is home to the tauren, a race of cow-like people in World of Warcraft. And right now, it is great to be a tauren. One tauren ability, called Plainsrunning, was almost forgotten. In the original beta, tauren did not get mounts at level 40, likely because they were too big and bulky to fit on a horse. Instead, they learned Plainsrunning, which let them run as fast as a mount. The idea did not last, and tauren were given kodos to ride instead. Plainsrunning was forgotten for years. Then it came back in the beta of WoW: Forever. This time, tauren slowly built up running speed as they moved, as long as they did not stop or get into combat. Over long distances, it could build up to a nice top speed. Then, after the beta shut down, Blizzard changed something. It boosted Plainsrunning to a cap of a 60-percent movement speed increase. It is as fast as an apprentice-level mount, which players do not get until level 40. This is available for tauren at level 1. Tauren are now zooming across Mulgore, there and gone in a flash. It does take time to build up to 60 percent. Tauren get a stack of Plainsrunning every few seconds, and each stack is worth a 2-percent increase, up to a cap of 30 stacks. But in older versions of World of Warcraft, there is a lot of running. Players travel long distances across whole zones and continents. Plainsrunning creeps up to top speed so gradually that it gives players the fun of moving quickly without taking away from that slower pace. You will need a horse to catch this cow.
why_it_matters: Small design choices like a forgotten running ability can change how a whole game feels to play, and bringing one back shows how game makers listen to what players enjoy. It also shows how an old idea can find new life years later.

background_read: World of Warcraft is a game where players explore a fantasy world as different races, including the tauren, cow-like people who live in Mulgore.
Tauren were once too big and bulky to ride horses, so they were given an ability called Plainsrunning that let them run as fast as a mount instead.
Plainsrunning was forgotten for years, but it returned in WoW: Forever, where tauren build up speed as they keep running until they reach a fast top speed.
That speed lets tauren travel quickly across long distances on foot, which fits a game where players spend a lot of time running between places.
